title: Rectilineal
summary: RECTILIN'EAL, RECTILIN'EAR, adjective [Latin rectus, right, and linea, line.] Right lined; consisting of a right line or of right lines; straight; as a rectilinear figure or course; a rectilinear side

inlines.v: RECTILIN'EAL, RECTILIN'EAR, adjective [Latin rectus, right, and linea, line.] Right lined; consisting of a right line or of right lines; straight; as a rectilinear figure or course; a rectilinear side or way.
